description: Fetch a country profile from ReliefWeb by ISO3 code, including overview, humanitarian situation summary, key content links, active appeals and response plans, and useful external links. Country profiles are curated by OCHA editors and provide the authoritative situation summary for humanitarian responders. Each curated list also has an archive — thousands of entries deep for a long-running crisis — which the profile leaves out. Two alternative selectors, at most one per call: sections names parts of the profile to return, archive pages one list's archived entries in place of the profile. A profile over the response budget comes back as a section outline naming every section and its byte size. Nothing is truncated on any path.

archive.description: Archive mode: return a page of one curated list's ARCHIVED entries instead of the country record. The response carries the record identity, the selected list, and total / shown / offset, plus a next offset while more entries remain. Mutually exclusive with sections — sections slices the record, archive replaces it — and a call supplying both is rejected. A record over the response budget still answers an archive call with the page: a page is bounded by limit and carries none of the record prose, so it never outlines.

limit.description: Maximum archived entries in one page (1-100).

list.description: Which curated list to page. The archived entries of that list are the ones the profile itself leaves out.

offset.description: Zero-based index of the first archived entry to return. Send back the nextOffset from the previous page to continue.

iso3.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code (e.g., SYR, AFG, UKR). Used to look up the country's ReliefWeb profile.

sections.description: Sections of the country record to return, named by the sections[].name values an outline response lists. Omit for the whole record, or for a section outline when the record is over the response budget. Identity metadata — the record's ID, its name, and its canonical URL — comes back alongside whatever is requested. The call is self-contained — the record is re-fetched and sliced, so no prior call has to be repeated. This names parts of the profile itself and never reaches archived entries — use archive for those.

items.description: A section name exactly as the outline response spelled it.

name: reliefweb_get_country

appealsResponsePlans.description: Currently-active humanitarian appeals and response plans for this country — the present set. The archived entries are reachable with archive: { list: "appealsResponsePlans" }.

items.description: An appeal or response plan entry.

archive.description: One page of a curated list's archived entries, returned in place of the record.

entries.description: The archived entries in this page, in ReliefWeb's own archive order.

date.description: Publication date, carried by appeals and response plans.

list.description: The curated list this page was read from.

nextOffset.description: Offset to send back to read the next page. Absent when this page reaches the end of the archive.

offset.description: Zero-based index of the first entry in this page.

shown.description: Number of entries in this page.

total.description: Total archived entries in that list for this record.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_found`: No country profile found for the given ISO3 code. `selector_conflict`: The call supplied both sections and archive, which select different things. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

keyContent.description: Currently-active curated key content links maintained by ReliefWeb editors — the present curated set. The archived entries are reachable with archive: { list: "keyContent" }.

kind.description: full when the record — or the sections asked for — is returned in whole; outline when the record exceeded the response budget and only its section index is returned; archive when the call asked for a page of one curated list's archived entries, which is returned in place of the record.

outlineNotice.description: How to re-call this tool for specific sections of the record.

profileOverview.description: Situation overview text from the ReliefWeb editorial team.

sections.description: Every section of the record, largest first. Pass the names back in `sections` to retrieve them.

items.description: One retrievable section of the record: its name and its serialized size.

bytes.description: Serialized byte size of the section

name.description: Section identifier — pass in `sections` to retrieve it

urlAlias.description: Canonical ReliefWeb URL for this country page.

usefulLinks.description: Currently-active useful external links curated by ReliefWeb editors — the present set. The archived entries are reachable with archive: { list: "usefulLinks" }.

title: Get ReliefWeb Country Profile
